originalTitle: Bungie says it’s ‘not done with Destiny’ and will bring back vaulted content

content: Months after seemingly giving up on Destiny 2, Bungie now says it’s planning to restore vaulted content in the game like campaigns, destinations, and raids. The decision reverses the Destiny Content Vault that Bungie created six years ago, controversially removing older content from Destiny 2 that players had paid to access. “We understand that removing these experiences had a lasting impact on player trust and enjoyment of Destiny,” admits Bungie. “We cannot change the decision we made, but we can acknowledge its impact and do the work to make it right by restoring these important parts of Destiny’s history.“ All Destiny 2 players will get access to the vaulted content, but it’s not a simple switch of a button for Bungie. The developer made big changes to Destiny 2 with the Beyond Light expansion, meaning it has to go back and update lighting, encounters, combatants, and other underlying systems for this older content. “That work will take time, but it is necessary to ensure returning content meets the stability and gameplay standards of Destiny 2 today,” says Bungie. [Media: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=asnrQ1UoBQM] The decision to return this content to Destiny 2 comes just weeks after a “Sunrise” Destiny 2 offline preservation mod appeared. The mod lets players access older areas in Destiny 2 that had been vaulted, but not the exact campaigns and missions that players had experienced previously. Bungie now says its own restoration project is the “first step to lay the foundation for how we reforge into new stories and games that you all deserve.” Could that be a Destiny 3 sequel? There’s no mention of such a project, despite fans desperately pleading for a successor to Destiny 2 in multiple high-profile Twitch streams in recent weeks. Bungie is only committing to building a “stronger long-term future for Destiny” right now. Alongside the Destiny 2 efforts, Bungie is also admitting that Marathon, its extraction shooter, didn’t “reach as many players as we had hoped, and we also know and understand that the game needs to evolve.” That means Marathon will expand deeper into a survival experience. The changes are a little vague right now, but it sounds like Marathon really needs to change and attract more players if it’s to be a sustainable project for Bungie.

chineseContent: 在看似放弃《命运 2》几个月后，Bungie 现在表示计划恢复游戏中的拱形内容，例如战役、目的地和突袭。这一决定推翻了 Bungie 六年前创建的《命运内容库》，颇具争议地删除了《命运 2》中玩家付费访问的旧内容。 “我们知道，消除这些体验会对玩家的信任和《命运》的享受产生持久的影响，”Bungie 承认。 “我们无法改变我们做出的决定，但我们可以承认它的影响，并通过恢复《命运》历史的这些重要部分来努力使其正确。”所有《命运 2》玩家都可以访问保管库内容，但这对 Bungie 来说并不是一个简单的按钮切换。开发者对《命运 2》的 Beyond Light 扩展包进行了重大更改，这意味着它必须返回并更新旧内容的照明、遭遇、战斗人员和其他底层系统。 “这项工作需要时间，但有必要确保返回的内容符合当今《命运 2》的稳定性和游戏标准，”Bungie 说。 [媒体：https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=asnrQ1UoBQM] 在“日出”命运 2 离线保存模组出现几周后，决定将这些内容返回到《命运 2》。该模组允许玩家访问《命运 2》中已拱顶的旧区域，但不能访问玩家之前经历过的确切战役和任务。 Bungie 现在表示，自己的修复项目是“为我们重新打造你们都应得的新故事和游戏奠定基础的第一步。”这会是《命运3》的续集吗？尽管最近几周粉丝们在多个备受瞩目的 Twitch 直播中拼命恳求《命运 2》的继任者，但并没有提及这样的项目。 Bungie 只承诺
